rationale.text: The html element carries lang=" fr", with a leading space. The glossary describes a code and an option separated by a hyphen, and does not say what the code part of a padded value is. The custom check answers cannot_tell on a value with surrounding whitespace; only the record supports this branch. The finding is needs_review: not_enabled at fail_only, alternative_unresolved at full.
